name: elite-credit-ai
description: Forensic credit-report analysis suite for US Latino consumers. Extracts data from US tri-bureau PDFs, runs 97 FCRA/FDCPA/Reg F compliance rules (cross-bureau and temporal), generates prioritized dispute strategies anchored to a 557-chunk legal RAG (17 federal laws + 5 state laws), produces FCRA-grade dispute letters, and tracks the consumer journey through a Repair / Optimization / Maintenance flow guide. Powered by Claude multi-agent orchestration plus the Elite Credit API (Railway) over MCP HTTP.
